title: How to organise the grill and outdoor cooking zone | Patio or Deck
description:
Cook over fire without leaving the grill to find a tool or wondering if there is gas.

This is the Grill and Outdoor Cooking Zone in the Patio or Deck. About 60-90 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Grates scraped bare, grease tray emptied and back in its rails, four tools on the grill's own hooks and no fifth anywhere, the propane tank upright with its level written on the collar, and a clear arm's length between the grill body and the siding, railing, and umbrella canopy.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Empty the side shelf and the cabinet under the grill.
Straighten: Hang the tongs and spatula on the grill's own hooks so you never walk away from a lit grill to go looking.
Shine: Burn the grates off, then pull the flavorizer bars and scrape the grease tray and drip pan out into the bin ra
Safety: Brush soapy water onto the propane hose and the regulator fitting, then open the valve.
Standardize: The grease tray gets emptied on a fixed count of cooks, marked off on a card taped inside the cabinet door.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Four tools on the hooks, grease tray emptied on a written count of cooks, and the tank level marked on the collar.
